# Live comparison design candidate

## Usage (caller’s view)

Install the skill’s pinned decoder once, then compare against an explicitly supplied development origin:

```sh
npm ci --prefix .agents/skills/verify
node .agents/skills/verify/scripts/compare-live.mjs --development http://localhost:5173
node .agents/skills/verify/scripts/compare-live.mjs --development https://dev.example.test --cases /tmp/selected-cases.json
node --test .agents/skills/verify/scripts/compare-live.test.mjs
```

Production defaults to `https://exposed.today`. Each run prints its evidence directory, counts of matched/different/error cases, and exits 0 only when every case matches; 1 means observed differences, 2 means invalid configuration or incomplete verification. Errors dominate differences. No “update baseline” operation exists.

A manifest contains search queries plus entity selectors, never expected financial values:

```ts
{
  searches: ['unite', 'west mid', 'hsbc', 'john mcdonnell', 'jahn'],
  organisations: [{ query: 'hsbc', name: '<exact observed name>', funderKind: '<observed kind>' }],
  members: [{ id: 178, name: '<exact observed name>' }]
}
```

Seed exact selectors from actual responses; include BBC/GB News/Premier League groups and two MPs where resolvable. Selection failure remains an error, never an automatic skip.

## Problem

Replace a frozen local database/golden comparison with live production versus development observations. Public data is SvelteKit page-data, not the private Rust API. Financial values are already authoritative strings; organisation UUIDs are installation-specific. Verification must distinguish application differences from unavailable or incomparable observations and retain evidence for diagnosis.

## Shape

Use one skill-owned Node module, one manifest, one focused test file, and a skill-local `package.json`/lockfile pinning `devalue` directly. Native fetch, filesystem, crypto, and test runner suffice. Delete the replaced golden helper/refresh workflow so verification has one default path. Keep existing focused application tests.

Sketch (types expressed as JSDoc in `.mjs`):

```ts
type Target = { role: 'production' | 'development'; origin: URL };
type ExactAmount = string | null; // parser accepts decimal strings only; never Number

type EntityIdentity =
  | { kind: 'MP'; id: number; name: string; context: object }
  | { kind: 'Funder'; name: string; funderKind: string };
type SearchRow = { identity: EntityIdentity; matchSource: object };
type Observation =
  | { kind: 'search'; query: string; rows: SearchRow[] }
  | { kind: 'member'; identity: EntityIdentity; totals: object }
  | { kind: 'organisation'; identity: EntityIdentity; totals: object };
type CaseResult =
  | { status: 'match'; caseId: string }
  | { status: 'different'; caseId: string; differences: Difference[] }
  | { status: 'error'; caseId: string; stage: string; message: string };

async function compareLive(options): Promise<RunReport> { throw Error('not implemented'); }
function parseManifest(input): Cases { throw Error('not implemented'); }
async function observe(target, caseSpec, evidence): Promise<Observation> { throw Error('not implemented'); }
function parsePageData(body, caseSpec): Observation { throw Error('not implemented'); }
function differences(left, right): Difference[] { throw Error('not implemented'); }
```

`observe` owns URL construction, sequential GETs with timeout and redirects rejected, raw evidence, official devalue decoding, structural validation, identity resolution, and projection. Route-specific parsers own required fields; no generic recursive numeric coercion. Search uses `/search/__data.json?q=...`; members and independently resolved funders use their detail routes. Require correct model/result/status and unique exact selectors. Preserve search ordering, multiplicity, provenance, and identity context; omit only installation-local funder IDs. Verify selected detail identity after fetching it.

Project member declared totals, dates, completeness, counts and currency/category summaries; project organisation currency/party/recipient totals and counts. Preserve amount strings, nulls, missing-data semantics, and stable member identities. Canonicalize unordered breakdowns by semantic keys; preserve meaningful ranked arrays. Fail missing required fields rather than defaulting them. Comparison is pure structured equality with JSON-path diffs.

A fresh exclusive run directory contains request URL/status/body and timing, origins, observable build metadata, manifest, normalized observations, report JSON and readable diffs. Write initial metadata before requests and finalize report even after case failures. Never reuse a prior observation as a live result. Reject equal normalized origins before fetching. Production and development remain read-only.

This single operation hides protocol and evidence policy behind two meaningful caller inputs (boundary discipline); no adapter framework or generic schema engine is warranted.

## Synthesis decision

Independent candidate: recommend the HTTP/devalue design as the base.

## Tradeoffs accepted

- Accept a pinned decoder dependency for correct SvelteKit deserialization.
- Accept explicit financial projections for auditable coverage and fail-closed schema changes.
- Accept live data drift; differences require diagnosis, not automatic regression attribution.

## Alternatives considered

Browser DOM comparison hides transport but exposes selectors, rounded display amounts, hydration and browser setup; it cannot establish exact underlying financial equality. Manual Python decoding avoids npm but makes a framework serialization protocol our responsibility.

## Implementation reconciliation

No deviations yet.

## Open questions and risks

Which reachable development origin represents this branch? Missing access blocks live proof, not implementation or replay validation.

## Next implementation step

Implement page-data fixture replay with mutations proving ordered search, cross-database UUID independence, exact amounts, missing fields, ambiguous selectors and request failures cannot falsely pass; then run the live comparison.

Design saved to `/tmp/exposed-live-design-astra.md` (768 words).

Recommend one skill-owned Node HTTP helper with pinned `devalue`, a selectors-only manifest, strict financial projections, independent organisation resolution, and persistent per-run evidence. Exit codes distinguish matches, differences, and incomplete verification.
